components.title: Part A: sum divisible by 11 not by 4
components.what: Sum all integers from 427 to 14294 inclusive divisible by 11 but not divisible by 4.

components.title: Part B: gross pay with daily OT rules
components.what: Compute gross pay at $18.50/hr with daily OT (1.5x over 8h, 2x over 12h, no weekly OT) for the 14 listed daily hours.

components.title: Part C: inclusion-exclusion count excluding multiples of 19
components.what: Count integers 1-8000 divisible by 6, 10, or 15, excluding those also divisible by 19.

components.title: Part D: FIFO COGS
components.what: Compute total cost of goods sold using FIFO for the given 8 purchase lots and 6 sales quantities in order.

challenges.problem: Recomputing the stated sums and counts finds no arithmetic error: Part A uses 1261 multiples of 11 and 315 multiples of 44; Part B totals 2520.625; Part C gives 2134 minus 112; Part D sells 366 units from lots 1-4 and 41 from lot 5.
The prompt says hours are paid at 1.5 times and 2 times the rate, which supports the draft's tiered-rate calculation; no alternative premium convention is specified.

The count of multiples of 11 from 427 to 14,294 appears wrong. The first multiple of 11 ≥ 427 is 429, and the last ≤ 14,294 is 14,289. Count = ((14289 - 429)/11) + 1 = (13860/11) + 1 = 1260 + 1 = 1261, which is correct. However, the count of multiples of 44 from 440 to 14,256 is ((14256 - 440)/44) + 1 = (13816/44) + 1 = 314 + 1 = 315, also correct. The arithmetic for S_11 and S_44 needs verification: S_11 = 1261/2 * (429 + 14289) = 630.5 * 14718 = 9,279,699. S_44 = 315/2 * (440 + 14256) = 157.5 * 14696 = 2,314,620. Difference = 6,965,079. This appears correct.

The daily pay calculations may have an error for the 9.5-hour days. The draft says 9.5 hrs: 148.00 + 1.5 × 27.75 = 189.625. But 9.5 hours means 8 regular + 1.5 overtime at 1.5x = 148 + 1.5*27.75 = 148 + 41.625 = 189.625, correct. The 13-hour day: 8 regular + 4 hours at 1.5x + 1 hour at 2x = 148 + 4*27.75 + 37 = 148 + 111 + 37 = 296, correct. The total: 2 days at 12.5 hrs = 2*277.50 = 555.00; 4 days at 8 hrs = 4*148 = 592.00; 2 days at 7.5 hrs = 2*138.75 = 277.50; 3 days at 9.5 hrs = 3*189.625 = 568.875; 1 day at 11 hrs = 231.25; 1 day at 0 hrs = 0; 1 day at 13 hrs = 296.00. Sum = 555 + 592 + 277.50 + 568.875 + 231.25 + 0 + 296 = 2520.625. Rounded to nearest cent = 2520.63. This appears correct.

The inclusion-exclusion formula for divisibility by 6, 10, or 15 is incorrect. The formula used: floor(8000/6) + floor(8000/10) + floor(8000/15) - 3*floor(8000/30) + floor(8000/30) = 1333 + 800 + 533 - 798 + 266 = 2134. This simplifies to 1333 + 800 + 533 - 798 + 266 = 2134. But the correct inclusion-exclusion for three sets A, B, C is |A∪B∪C| = |A| + |B| + |C| - |A∩B| - |A∩C| - |B∩C| + |A∩B∩C|. Here A = multiples of 6, B = multiples of 10, C = multiples of 15. A∩B = multiples of lcm(6,10)=30, A∩C = multiples of lcm(6,15)=30, B∩C = multiples of lcm(10,15)=30. So all pairwise intersections are multiples of 30, and the triple intersection is also multiples of 30. Thus |A∩B| = |A∩C| = |B∩C| = |A∩B∩C| = floor(8000/30) = 266. The correct formula should be 1333 + 800 + 533 - 266 - 266 - 266 + 266 = 2134. The draft's formula -3*floor(8000/30) + floor(8000/30) = -2*floor(8000/30) = -532, which is equivalent to -266 -266 -266 +266 = -532. So the result 2134 is correct. However, the count of numbers also divisible by 19 is computed with a similar formula: floor(8000/114) + floor(8000/190) + floor(8000/285) - 3*floor(8000/570) + floor(8000/570) = 70 + 42 + 28 - 42 + 14 = 112. Here the lcm of 6 and 19 is 114, 10 and 19 is 190, 15 and 19 is 285. The pairwise intersections of these three sets would be lcm(6,10,19)=570, lcm(6,15,19)=570, lcm(10,15,19)=570, and triple intersection also 570. So the correct formula is 70 + 42 + 28 - 14 - 14 - 14 + 14 = 112. The draft's formula gives 70+42+28 - 3*14 + 14 = 140 - 42 + 14 = 112. So the result 112 is correct. Then 2134 - 112 = 2022. This appears correct.

The total units sold is 407, but the sum of units in lots 1-5 used is 56+114+89+107+41 = 407, which matches. The cost calculation: Lot 1: 56*5.36 = 300.16; Lot 2: 114*10.90 = 1242.60; Lot 3: 89*6.32 = 562.48; Lot 4: 107*6.11 = 653.77; Lot 5: 41*10.04 = 411.64. Sum = 300.16 + 1242.60 + 562.48 + 653.77 + 411.64 = 3170.65. This appears correct.
